item.title: How one hacker used AI agents and a few thousand dollars to break into scores of sites
item.description: Over the past couple of weeks, a cybersecurity researcher watched as a Chinese-speaking hacker broke into websites belonging to more than 100 companies, including farm equipment maker Deere , home appliance company SharkNinja and engine manufacturer Cummins .
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: Over the past couple of weeks, a cybersecurity researcher watched as a Chinese-speaking hacker broke into websites belonging to more than 100 companies, including farm equipment maker Deere (DE.N) , home appliance company SharkNinja (SN.N) and engine manufacturer Cummins (CMI.N) . Yet the hacker did almost none of the work. The cybercriminal instead outsourced the hacking spree almost entirely to artificial intelligence, tasking AI agents with spending hours autonomously probing and breaking into targeted sites, according to Snorre Fagerland, principal threat researcher at the cybersecurity company NorForge. In a report provided to Reuters ahead of publication on Monday , Fagerland said the hacker was one of several he discovered while scanning the web for inadvertently exposed instances of Cairn, an open-source AI problem-solving platform popular with hackers. Beginning around October 2, Fagerland said he found about two dozen instances of Cairn being used for malicious activity, which allowed him to quietly peer over the cybercriminals' shoulders as they set their AI tools loose on the world. Fagerland's report on the Chinese-speaking hacker did not name the victims, but Reuters was able to establish the victims' identities by independently reviewing the hacker's Cairn activity. At a time of [USN:L4N456128 TEXT:"rising anxiety"] over the power of autonomous AI tools, Fagerland said his find was real-life evidence that commercially available AI agents could pull off complex intrusions from start to finish without human intervention, a dramatic boost to the power of a single malicious actor. "It's a new world now," said Fagerland. Reuters could not ascertain the degree to which the breaches resulted in unauthorized extraction of data. Deere told Reuters it had taken "necessary remediation actions" following the incident and had "no indication that sensitive information was accessed." SharkNinja said the hack had hit a standalone site carrying only product support information and that the threat had been contained. Cummins said it was "investigating the report of a potential cyber-attack on a website operated by one of our third-party vendors." Two smaller businesses also acknowledged being compromised. Other victims listed in the Cairn data did not return messages. FEW INSTRUCTIONS, MANY HACKS One of the hackers that Fagerland observed stole a trove of credit card data. Another tried to get AI agents to rob a cryptocurrency exchange. The Chinese-speaking hacker was the most prolific. Beginning on September 25, they set their AI army loose against US, Canadian, Australian and Japanese e-commerce websites. Their instructions were terse, sketching out their preferred intrusion tactics in fewer than 100 Chinese characters. As of late last week, their agents had attempted to break into more than 1,200 sites. Successful intrusions typically took around 23 hours of poking and prodding for vulnerabilities. Fagerland estimated that the campaign, which appeared to be using a mixture of China's DeepSeek and Anthropic's Claude Code, had chewed up roughly $5,000 worth of tokens, or about $50 per successful hack. Fagerland — who has worked in cybersecurity for nearly three decades — said he was impressed by some of the techniques the agents used to compromise their victims. In one case, after failing to find any weaknesses in a big company's public-facing application, the AI agents pored through digital records to find associated infrastructure, located a public-facing control panel, discovered a subtle weakness in the way it processed data, and after hours of trial and error, reported leveraging it to trick the server into executing malicious commands. "It's not straightforward to come up with solutions like that," Fagerland said. "It's not script kiddie stuff." Cairn's author, whose social media handle is "le1xia0", acknowledged receipt of a Reuters message but did not immediately answer a list of questions. In a recent post on X, they said their platform was "an innovative type of multi-agent architecture and was not designed for hacking attacks. If it is used to carry out harmful hacking attacks, that is not my intention." NO SUPERVISION NEEDED The ability of agentic AI systems to autonomously discover vulnerabilities, conduct intrusions, and steal data is a source of increasing anxiety around the world. Rogue agents inadvertently unleashed by major AI companies have [USN:L6N45H0LE TEXT:"hacked their way out of computer labs"][USN:L6N45H0LE TEXT:","] [USN:L4N45G0G8 TEXT:"broken into government websites"], and engaged in [USN:L6N44B0TQ TEXT:"unsanctioned social engineering attempts"]. South Korea and Japan have in recent weeks been buffeted by a series of well-publicized hacks attributed to [USN:L1N45U0IU TEXT:"AI-using cybercriminals"]. AI agents are increasingly becoming staples of the cybercriminal underground. In August, the Israeli firm Gambit Security found that Russian-speaking extortionists had [USN:L6N44N0S2 TEXT:"leveraged SpaceX's Cursor AI tool"] to break into seven organizations. In September, Gambit documented an AI agent-driven spree that resulted in breaches at 25 companies and the theft of at least 600,000 credit card records. Last week, the cyber intelligence company Bitsight said that discussions about how to use autonomous agents were surging across cybercriminal forums . Fagerland said he had previously assumed hacker-agents would need at least some supervision. He said it was now obvious that the technology had moved past that. "The development in this field is astounding," he said.

item.title: Albertsons begins its $8 billion trial against Kroger over failed merger
item.description: US grocery chain Albertsons Companies will begin making its case in court on Monday for more than $8 billion in damages against larger rival Kroger for allegedly sinking their agreed $24.6 billion merger two years ago.
item.dc:creator: Tom Hals
item.content:encoded: US grocery chain Albertsons Companies (ACI.N) will begin making its case in court on Monday for more than $8 billion in damages against larger rival Kroger (KR.N) for allegedly sinking their agreed $24.6 billion merger two years ago. Idaho-based Albertsons, whose chains include Safeway, Acme and Kings Food Markets, claims that Kroger broke its commitment to obtain regulatory approval for the deal by refusing to sell a sufficient number of stores. As a result, Albertsons said it is owed a premium of up to $6.88 billion the deal would have delivered to its shareholders, as well as the $600 million termination fee and more than $1 billion in tax adjustments. The bench trial is scheduled to run two weeks in Delaware's Court of Chancery in front of Vice Chancellor Lori Will. Rulings often take months after the trial ends and the outcome can be appealed to the Delaware Supreme Court. The 2022 merger was meant to position the two companies and their 5,000 stores to better compete with newer entrants into grocery markets such as Walmart (WMT.O) , Costco (COST.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) and Aldi. However, combining the largest and second-largest US grocers was challenged by states and the administration of Democratic President Joe Biden, which argued the deal would remove direct competition and lead to higher prices at checkout. In December 2024, federal and state courts blocked the deal and Albertsons immediately terminated the merger, which Ohio-based Kroger said cut off its ability to appeal. Since the termination, Kroger's stock has risen about 4% and Albertsons has lost nearly 30%, both lagging the S&P 500 index, which rose by more than a quarter. The trial comes a week after Albertsons [USN:L6N45Z0QH TEXT:"unveiled"] a cost-cutting review of its business and after Kroger, which owns the Dillons, Ralphs and Fred Meyer chains, [USN:L4N45Y19P TEXT:"planned to cut"] 3,000 jobs and invest in technology to lower prices. Albertsons said that Kroger violated what it claimed was an obligation to take "any and all actions" to get antitrust approval, up to selling 650 stores. Albertsons described in court papers the various divestiture packages that Kroger offered regulators as an attempt to minimize what it had to sell to protect the profitability of the post-merger business, rather than to get regulatory clearance. It said Kroger created a $400 million executive bonus pool to encourage senior managers to take a highly aggressive approach to demands from regulators. Kroger said in its court papers Albertsons was misreading the merger agreement and said that it kept its obligations, pinning the deal failure on regulatory opposition. It said that the Biden administration wanted it to sell more than 650 stores and courts blocked the merger because they took a narrow view of the grocery market by excluding Amazon, Costco and others. ALBERTSONS CEO COULD BE WITNESS Kroger spent more than $1 billion and tens of thousands of hours of employee and adviser time trying to close the deal, which it said was evidence it was not willfully breaching the merger agreement. Kroger said it will prove at the trial that Albertsons isn't entitled to the termination fee because it claims Albertsons undermined Kroger's ability to negotiate. It blamed that in part on allegedly unauthorized communications about the divestment plan by Susan Morris, who is now Albertsons' CEO. Albertsons said there is zero evidence Morris shared sensitive information. In addition to Morris, other potential witnesses include Rodney McMullen and Vivek Sankaran, who were CEOs of Kroger and Albertsons respectively at the time of the merger but who have since been replaced, according to court documents. Dozens of other potential witnesses include deal advisers, expert witnesses and current and former executives and directors.

item.title: Two Serbian opposition figures targeted with spyware, research group says
item.description: Two Serbian opposition figures were recently targeted with powerful cyberespionage tools, according to one of the men and a report issued on Monday by the Canadian cyber watchdog group Citizen Lab.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter
item.content:encoded: Two Serbian opposition figures were recently targeted with powerful cyberespionage tools, according to one of the men and a report issued on Monday by the Canadian cyber watchdog group Citizen Lab. The incident was the latest of several in which researchers say surveillance technology was used against students, opposition politicians and others in Serbia, which will hold a [USN:L8N4501TC TEXT:"parliamentary election"] on Sunday. Citizen Lab said on Monday that a joint investigation with the Share Foundation, a digital rights group, determined that Serbian academic Vladan Djokic's iPhone had been hacked using the Pegasus spyware tool made by Israeli group NSO. At the same time, former prosecutor Rade Bajic told Reuters he received a warning from Apple on August 13 that his phone had been targeted using "mercenary spyware," although he and Citizen Lab both said they had been unable to establish with certainty whether he was hacked or how a hack might have happened. Serbia's Interior Ministry did not return messages seeking comment. Officials there have previously dismissed allegations of cyberespionage. NSO, which was [USN:L1N2RU186 TEXT:"blacklisted by the US government"] in 2021 following years of reports of alleged human rights abuses, did not return emails. NSO, which says it only sells to governments, has previously said it would terminate commercial relationships that result in serious wrongdoing. Apple confirmed having sent a batch of warnings to users on August 13 but did not directly address questions about Bajic's or Djokic's cases. Both men have crossed Serbia's ruling party, which has been buffeted by two years of [USN:L8N430061 TEXT:"student-led anti-corruption protests"]. Djokic, the rector of the University of Belgrade, has been under pressure from authorities following his [USN:L1N40J13I TEXT:"expressions of solidarity with the students"]. Bajic said he was involved in [USN:L1N3XL0NL TEXT:"prosecuting senior government officials"] over allegations that they improperly removed cultural protections on [USN:L8N3WN0WT TEXT:"a historic Belgrade army compound"] that an investment company founded by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, had planned to redevelop. Kushner's company [USN:L8N3XT0EU TEXT:"pulled out of the plan"] late last year, saying it was doing so out of respect for the people of Serbia and the city of Belgrade. "In my opinion, my involvement in this case was the sole reason for this unlawful spyware attack," Bajic said. Last month, the Share Foundation said that at least 14 people, including students, activists and opposition party members, had been [USN:L6N44T16U TEXT:"targeted with advanced spyware"] ahead of local elections in March. At least one of the devices was compromised using Pegasus, it said.

item.title: UBS prevé que el ciclo de subidas de tasas del BCE se prolongue hasta marzo de 2027
item.description: UBS Global Research dijo el lunes que espera que el Banco Central Europeo suba las tasas de interés en 25 puntos básicos en marzo de 2027, tras una subida en diciembre, debido al deterioro de las perspectivas de inflación.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UBS Global Research dijo el lunes que espera que el Banco Central Europeo suba las tasas de interés en 25 puntos básicos en marzo de 2027, tras una subida en diciembre, debido al deterioro de las perspectivas de inflación. La agencia de valores había previsto anteriormente que el ciclo de subidas de tasas del BCE concluyera en diciembre.

item.title: Auswärtiges Amt bestellt iranischen Botschafter ein
item.description: Das Auswärtige Amt hat den iranischen Botschafter in Berlin einbestellt. Hintergrund sind staatlich gelenkte iranische Attentatspläne gegen jüdische Vertreter in Deutschland. Angriffe auf jüdisches Leben und auf diejenigen, die es verteidigen, würden nicht toleriert, teilte das Ministerium am Montag auf der Plattform X mit. Die Attentatsversuche auf den Präsidenten des Zentralrats der Juden, Josef Schuster, und den Präsidenten der Deutsch-Israelischen Gesellschaft, Volker Beck, hätten juristische Konsequenzen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Das Auswärtige Amt hat den iranischen Botschafter in Berlin einbestellt. Hintergrund sind staatlich gelenkte iranische Attentatspläne gegen jüdische Vertreter in Deutschland. Angriffe auf jüdisches Leben und auf diejenigen, die es verteidigen, würden nicht toleriert, teilte das Ministerium am Montag auf der Plattform X mit. Die Attentatsversuche auf den Präsidenten des Zentralrats der Juden, Josef Schuster, und den Präsidenten der Deutsch-Israelischen Gesellschaft, Volker Beck, hätten juristische Konsequenzen. Man verurteile die Aktivitäten Teherans aufs Allerschärfste und werde nicht zulassen, dass das Land die freiheitliche Gesellschaft bedrohe, erklärte das Auswärtige Amt weiter. Das Ministerium verwies zudem darauf, dass sich die Bundesregierung erfolgreich für eine Einstufung der iranischen Revolutionsgarden als Terrororganisation in der EU eingesetzt habe. Außenminister Johann Wadephul hatte am Freitag vor hybriden Angriffen des Regimes in Europa gewarnt und der Führung in Teheran mit Konsequenzen gedroht. Europa befinde sich im Fadenkreuz Irans, erklärte Wadephul. Der Außenminister reagierte damit auf ein Urteil des Oberlandesgerichts Hamburg vom vergangenen Donnerstag. Das Gericht hatte zwei Männer mit Verbindungen nach Teheran wegen versuchter Mordanschläge auf Schuster und Beck zu mehrjährigen Haftstrafen verurteilt. Nach Überzeugung der Hamburger Richter wurde einer der Verurteilten vom iranischen Geheimdienst rekrutiert, um staatlich gesteuerte Terroranschläge in Deutschland zu verüben. Der dänische Staatsbürger erhielt eine Haftstrafe von acht Jahren und sechs Monaten. Ein mitangeklagter afghanischer Staatsbürger wurde zu vier Jahren und sechs Monaten Haft verurteilt.

item.title: JPMorgan announces $5 billion in investments in companies critical to US national security
item.description: JPMorgan Chase said it has invested $5 billion in equity in industries critical to US economic and national security, as banks seek to capitalize on growing demand for domestic manufacturing, energy infrastructure and supply-chain resilience.
item.dc:creator: Nupur Anand
item.content:encoded: JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) said it has invested $5 billion in equity in industries critical to US economic and national security, as banks seek to capitalize on growing demand for domestic manufacturing, energy infrastructure and supply-chain resilience. The lender also announced it has financed about $230 billion under its Security and Resiliency Initiative since launching the [USN:L3N3VU00I TEXT:"effort a year ago"], when it committed to financing $1.5 trillion of US investments in the next decade, including in national security. Large US banks have already been investing in rising demand for AI data centers, critical minerals and energy infrastructure upgrades, as President Donald Trump's administration has prioritized growing US infrastructure to reduce dependence on foreign supply chains in various sectors, including clean energy and rare earths. JPMorgan said its own investments have supported companies in sectors including advanced manufacturing, energy, supply chains and defense-related technologies. The bank's equity investments are in venture, growth and later-stage companies, it said, including new investments around next-generation defense technologies, distributed battery storage, automated manufacturing and frontier technologies. "In the next leg we are going to be focusing on expanding industrial capacity, strengthen supply chains and support the industries that will shape long-term economic resilience and national security," said Jay Horine, head of the security and resiliency initiative at JPMorganChase Global Banking. Other banks are also working on similar initiatives. Bank of America (BAC.N) in August said it [USN:L4N4480ML TEXT:"plans to invest $250 billion"] by July 2027 to support US digital and infrastructure projects. Morgan Stanley (MS.N) has also said it would [USN:FWN4471S3 TEXT:"facilitate roughly $1.5 trillion in investments over the next decade"] for technology and infrastructure projects.

item.title: TSX futures edge lower as oil slips; eyes on inflation data
item.description: Futures tracking Canada's blue-chip stocks edged lower on Monday, as oil prices slipped following last week's sharp gains, while investors awaited domestic inflation data for clues on the interest rate path.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Futures tracking Canada's blue-chip stocks edged lower on Monday, as oil prices slipped following last week's sharp gains, while investors awaited domestic inflation data for clues on the interest rate path. December futures on the S&P/TSX index slipped 0.16% at 05:50 a.m. ET (09:50 GMT). Brent crude slipped 1.3% from a five-month high on profit taking as US waiver of sanctions on Russia improved the supply outlook Still, with oil prices at $105 a barrel, the [USN:L6N463037 TEXT:"Bank of Canada expects"] to raise its quarterly inflation forecast significantly this month, the central bank Governor Tiff Macklem said on Saturday Canada's September consumer price index (CPI) data is expected later in the day, with economists polled by Reuters anticipating a 0.2% rise in inflation. Traders are pricing in a 35% chance of a rate hike next week, and nearly a 70% chance of a quarter point increase by year-end, according to LSEG data Spot gold prices held firm as lower oil prices eased immediate concerns over inflation Reliance Worldwide (RWC.AX) said on Monday that no rival bidder emerged during the "go shop process under Brookfield's (BN.TO) [USN:L1N46406G TEXT:"proposed acquisition"] of the Australian firm Attention will also shift to Wall Street earnings from Meta Platforms (META.O) and Elon Musk-led Tesla (TSLA.O) and Spacex (SPCX.O) later this week FOR CANADIAN MARKETS NEWS, CLICK ON CODES: TSX market report Canadian dollar and bonds report CA/ Reuters global stocks poll for Canada , Canadian markets directory

item.title: Lee says S Korea capable of taking back wartime command of combined US forces
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Monday the country is fully capable of taking back the wartime operational control of the combined forces with the US stationed in the country and talks with Washington for the change are progressing.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Monday the country is fully capable of taking back the wartime operational control of the combined forces with the US stationed in the country and talks with Washington for the change are progressing. Lee also said South Korea has built a powerful military that can counter North Korea even though Pyongyang has developed nuclear weapons, which he said are fundamentally a means for final defence, not for combat in a war. "To put it plainly, we should take back wartime operation control at an early time. We are fully capable of it and discussions with the US are basically going well," Lee told reporters at the Blue House presidential compound. But the process is far from simple, as it has been 70 years since operational control was entrusted to the US, he added. South Korea made the decision during the 1950-53 Korean War, enabling the US military to lead the UN forces fighting for South Korea. The two countries agreed in 2007 to eventually transfer the command control to South Korea. The US stations about 28,500 troops and military hardware in South Korea in combined defence against North Korea, which has pursued nuclear arms and ballistic missile development. The two Koreas remain technically at war under a truce. Lee has said he aims to complete the transfer of the overall command of the combined US-South Korea allied forces at a time of war, a goal pursued by successive South Korean governments for decades, before his five-year term ends in 2030. Such a change would mean a South Korean general rather than a U.S. commander would lead allied South Korean and U.S. forces in the event of a war with North Korea. The allies have been engaged in discussions to evaluate readiness of the South Korean military to take on such a command, but there appeared to be some disagreement. The commander of the US Forces Korea, [USN:L1N461021 TEXT:"General Xavier Brunson"], said this week the security environment had changed since the allies established the transfer requirements. South Korean media have reported that Seoul favours 2028 as the target year for the transfer, while Brunson told a US congressional hearing in April that the US military had submitted a roadmap aimed at meeting the conditions by early 2029.

item.title: Operadores de red europeos barajan presentar una oferta conjunta para la telefonía por satélite
item.description: Deutsche Telekom , Orange , Telefónica y Vodafone han acordado estudiar la posibilidad de presentar una oferta conjunta para la adjudicación de espectro destinado a servicios móviles por satélite en Europa, informaron el lunes los operadores de red.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Deutsche Telekom (DTEGn.DE) , Orange (ORAN.PA) , Telefónica (TEF.MC) y Vodafone (VOD.L) han acordado estudiar la posibilidad de presentar una oferta conjunta para la adjudicación de espectro destinado a servicios móviles por satélite en Europa, informaron el lunes los operadores de red. Como parte de esta iniciativa, las cuatro empresas tienen previsto establecer una infraestructura terrestre de referencia, así como importantes funciones de coordinación y control en Europa, indicaron.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO anchor investor quota nearly 30 times oversubscribed
item.description: Jio Platforms is set to raise up to $3.2 billion at a valuation of $108.3 billion in what will be India's biggest ever IPO ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mukesh Ambani's $3.2 billion Jio Platforms IPO has drawn bids from institutions including GIC, BlackRock and Fidelity, totaling almost 30 times the quota reserved for anchor investors, a person with direct knowledge said.The telecoms, cloud and AI group on Monday opened its record initial public offering to institutional investors who can bid for up to 30% of the offering reserved exclusively for them, before the issue opens for public subscription on Wednesday.Jio Platforms is set to raise up to $3.2 billion at a valuation of $108.3 billion in what will be India's biggest ever IPO.Fidelity, Singapore's GIC, Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and BlackRock were among the investors to place bids for the institutional quota, the person told Reuters.Reliance, which is the ultimate owner of Jio Platforms, did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.ADIA, BlackRock, Fidelity and GIC did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

item.title: Ações chinesas fecham em alta; PIB forte supera cautela com setor de IA
item.description: As ações chinesas fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, impulsionadas pelas ações bancárias, já que os dados otimistas do PIB do terceiro trimestre superaram o clima de cautela em relação a algumas empresas da cadeia de suprimentos de IA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As ações chinesas fecharam em alta nesta segunda-feira, impulsionadas pelas ações bancárias, já que os dados otimistas do PIB do terceiro trimestre superaram o clima de cautela em relação a algumas empresas da cadeia de suprimentos de IA. No fechamento, o índice de Xangai (.SSEC) teve alta de 0,4%, enquanto o índice CSI300 (.CSI300) , que reúne as maiores companhias listadas em Xangai e Shenzhen, avançou 0,1%. O mercado de Hong Kong ficou fechado devido a um feriado local e retomará as negociações na terça-feira. A economia chinesa cresceu 4,5% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior no terceiro trimestre, superando as previsões e reduzindo a pressão sobre Pequim para ampliar os estímulos à economia para atingir sua meta de crescimento anual. As vendas no varejo em setembro também aceleraram. "Apesar da surpresa nos dados de setembro, o desempenho nos primeiros nove meses de 2026 ainda intensificou as preocupações domésticas e globais sobre o desequilíbrio da China", afirmaram analistas do ANZ em uma nota. "O apoio fiscal continua sendo crucial, já que as restrições políticas limitam a flexibilização monetária em meio às pressões de recessão no balanço patrimonial", afirmaram. Setores tradicionais, como bancos (.CSI399986) e bebidas alcoólicas (.CSI399997) , lideraram os ganhos no mercado interno, com alta de 1,5% e 0,8%, respectivamente. O índice STAR50, voltado para o setor de tecnologia (.STAR50) , registrou queda de 2,2%, já que o otimismo em relação à cadeia de suprimentos de chips de IA continuou fraco. As ações da fabricante de robôs Unitree (688836.SS) subiram 16%, recuperando-se da mínima histórica atingida na semana passada, enquanto as da fabricante de chips de memória CXMT (688825.SS) caíram 7,8%. . Em TÓQUIO, o índice Nikkei (.N225) recuou 0,62%, a 64.916 pontos. . Em HONG KONG, o índice HANG SENG (.HSI) permaneceu fechado. . Em XANGAI, o índice SSEC (.SSEC) ganhou 0,39%, a 3.730 pontos. . O índice CSI300 (.CSI300) , que reúne as maiores companhias listadas em XANGAI e SHENZHEN, avançou 0,09%, a 4.174 pontos. . Em SEUL, o índice KOSPI (.KS11) teve valorização de 1,76%, a 5.768 pontos. . Em TAIWAN, o índice TAIEX (.TWII) registrou baixa de 0,61%, a 46.822 pontos. . Em CINGAPURA, o índice STRAITS TIMES (.STI) desvalorizou-se 0,07%, a 5.412 pontos. . Em SYDNEY, o índice S&P/ASX 200 (.AXJO) avançou 0,44%, a 8.845 pontos. (Reportagem da Redação de Xangai)

item.title: El papa León celebrará la audiencia del miércoles por primera vez desde su operación de cáncer
item.description: El papa León XIV celebrará el miércoles una audiencia general con los peregrinos en el Vaticano por primera vez desde que se sometió a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón, según ha informado el Vaticano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León XIV celebrará el miércoles una audiencia general con los peregrinos en el Vaticano por primera vez desde que se sometió a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón, según ha informado el Vaticano. El pontífice, de 71 años, fue operado el 13 de octubre para extirparle el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho, lo que ha alimentado las especulaciones sobre cómo su enfermedad podría afectar a sus 17 meses de papado. León se comprometió el domingo, en su primer acto público desde la intervención, a reanudar poco a poco sus actividades habituales como líder de los 1.400 millones de católicos del mundo. El papa celebra una audiencia general con los peregrinos casi todos los miércoles del año. Esta tiene lugar en la plaza de San Pedro o en el interior, dependiendo del tiempo.

item.title: UK urges firms not to take part in E1 settlement tender or risk sanctions
item.description: British foreign minister Ed Miliband on Monday urged companies and individuals not to proceed with bids for the E1 West Bank settlement project on Monday, warning those involved in the construction of illegal settlements could face sanctions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British foreign minister Ed Miliband on Monday urged companies and individuals not to proceed with bids for the E1 West Bank settlement project on Monday, warning those involved in the construction of illegal settlements could face sanctions. "We urge businesses and individuals not to proceed with bids for E1 construction tenders," Miliband said in a statement. "They should be aware of legal and reputational consequences, including the risk of involving themselves in serious breaches of international law." The E1 project would bisect the Israeli-occupied West Bank and cut it off from East Jerusalem, fragmenting the land Palestinians hope will form the heart of a state. Many Western states and campaign groups have opposed the project over concerns that it could undermine a future peace deal with the Palestinians.

item.title: China's central bank studies making overnight rate its main policy rate
item.description: China's central bank is considering switching its main policy rate to the overnight reverse repurchase rate, state media reported on Monday, in a shift aimed at improving the transmission of monetary policy to support the economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's central bank is considering switching its main policy rate to the overnight reverse repurchase rate, state media reported on Monday, in a shift aimed at improving the transmission of monetary policy to support the economy. The overnight repo rate would replace the seven-day reverse repo rate, which has served as the main policy benchmark since 2024. People's Bank of China Governor Pan Gongsheng said the change is part of efforts to refine the central bank's control of short-term interest rates, according to central bank-run Financial News. "Currently, the interbank overnight repo rate has effectively become the target rate for the PBOC's monetary policy," Pan was quoted as saying at a key financial forum in Beijing. "It sensitively reflects the supply and demand for short-term liquidity and has shown greater stability in recent years." The change will make interest rate control more precise, Pan said. The policy shift gives the PBOC greater control over liquidity conditions and brings its policy framework more in line with global peers. Central banks such as the US Federal Reserve already use overnight rates as their main policy rates to better anchor the yield curve. China's 30-year government bond yield fell more than 1 basis point after the announcement. The PBOC will also widen the range of institutions eligible to use its Standing Lending Facility and set up a liquidity support tool for non-bank financial institutions, Pan said. The measures are aimed at strengthening liquidity support for non-bank institutions, including insurers and fund managers.

item.title: EU says KKR might have misled it over Telecom Italia deal
item.description: The EU Commission on Monday said US investment firm KKR might have provided it incorrect or misleading information over its up to €22 billion ($24.7 billion) acquisition of Telecom Italia's fixed-line network.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The EU Commission on Monday said US investment firm KKR (KKR.N) might have provided it incorrect or misleading information over its up to €22 billion ($24.7 billion) acquisition of Telecom Italia's (TLIT.MI) fixed-line network. The Commission [USN:L8N3HX3KA TEXT:"approved"] the deal in 2024, but opened an investigation following complaints by other operators in 2025. They argued that prices for them to access TIM's fixed broadband network had been unilaterally increased after the deal, even though KKR had convinced the Commission that it would not have the power to deteriorate conditions for wholesale access. The Commission said the new investigation had led to the preliminary view that KKR "at least negligently, submitted incorrect and/or misleading information on the terms of its existing long-term agreements for wholesale access, including on the fact that their existing terms would continue to apply." It said it had sent these objections to KKR, which would now have the opportunity to respond. ($1 = 0.8919 euros)

item.title: Wall St futures climb as AI stocks rebound; oil, yields fall
item.description: US stock index futures gained on Monday as AI-related shares rebounded from last week's sharp selloff, with easing oil prices and Treasury yields adding to investor optimism.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US stock index futures gained on Monday as AI-related shares rebounded from last week's sharp selloff, with easing oil prices and Treasury yields adding to investor optimism. The benchmark S&P 500 (.SPX) and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) posted their biggest weekly drop since late June on Friday, pressured by technology firms as concerns grew that higher interest rates could hamper investments into AI infrastructure, particularly among data center operators. However, AI-linked stocks such as CoreWeave (CRWV.O) climbed 1.3% in premarket trading on Monday, while Broadcom (AVGO.O) added 2.3%. Megacap stocks also climbed, with Nvidia (NVDA.O) rising 1.1%. Amazon.com (AMZN.O) and Meta Platforms (META.O) were up marginally. Brent futures fell 1.8% to around $107 a barrel, following US President Donald Trump's decision to [USN:L6N464042 TEXT:"waive some sanctions"] on Russia. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday the president would take up to 60 days to assess the economic impact of such a move. At the same time, the benchmark 10-year yield fell to 5.085%. Meanwhile, Iran reported [USN:S8N44Y01I TEXT:"another tanker"] had hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz, while the cost of shipping and insurance was keeping oil prices for actual delivery a lot higher. At 04:59 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 18 points, or 0.03%, S&P 500 E-minis were up 36 points, or 0.47%, and Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 292.25 points, or 0.99%. Investors are also looking ahead to a busy week of earnings from major technology companies. Meta (META.O) is expected to beat Wall Street estimates when it reports this week. Elon Musk-led Tesla (TSLA.O) is due to report on Wednesday, while SpaceX (SPCX.O) is scheduled to release results on Tuesday. Netflix (NFLX.O) , General Motors (GM.N) and GE Aerospace (GE.N) are also among the companies reporting results this week. Intel shares rose 3.8% after [USN:L6N4650J6 TEXT:"JPMorgan upgraded"] the stock to "neutral" from "underweight." Red Cat Holdings (RCAT.O) climbed 6.9% after the drone maker said it [USN:L8N4650CZ TEXT:"plans to acquire"] Austrian engine and engine parts manufacturer Steyr Motors (4X0.VI) in a deal valued at about €204.8 million ($230 million).

item.title: 豪で議員が重体、車で故意にはねられる 男を逮捕
item.description:
Alasdair Pal
[シドニー １９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alasdair Pal

[シドニー １９日 ロイター] - 豪ビクトリア州で１９日、無所属のヘレン・ヘインズ議員（６５）が自身の事務所の外で車で故意にはねられ、重体となっている。警察とアルバニージー首相が発表した。

同州警察によると、この事件で４３歳の男が逮捕された。現場はメルボルンから北東へ車で約３時間の場所にあるワンガラッタ。

首相によると、ヘインズ氏はヘリコプターで病院に搬送された。

首相は会見で、同氏の回復を祈っていると述べた。

州警察は会見で、一般市民に対するさらなる脅威はないと発表した。

首相は、襲撃の動機を特定するには時期尚早であるとしつつも、テロ対策特別班が逮捕された容疑者の捜査にあたると述べた。

item.title: Telekom & Co bieten gemeinsam für Mobilfunkfrequenzen per Satellit
item.description: Die Deutsche Telekom will mit mehreren Partnern ein europäisches Netz für Satelliten-Telefonie über herkömmliche Smartphones aufbauen. Der Bonner Konzern teilte am Montag mit, er habe mit Telefonica aus Spanien, Vodafone aus Großbritannien und Orange aus Frankreich eine entsprechende Absichtserklärung unterzeichnet. Die Unternehmen wollten sich gemeinsam um Funkfrequenzen für mobile Satellitendienste bewerben.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die Deutsche Telekom (DTEGn.DE) will mit mehreren Partnern ein europäisches Netz für Satelliten-Telefonie über herkömmliche Smartphones aufbauen. Der Bonner Konzern teilte am Montag mit, er habe mit Telefonica (TEF.MC) aus Spanien, Vodafone (VOD.L) aus Großbritannien und Orange (ORAN.PA) aus Frankreich eine entsprechende Absichtserklärung unterzeichnet. Die Unternehmen wollten sich gemeinsam um Funkfrequenzen für mobile Satellitendienste bewerben. Die vier Konzerne würden die notwendige Infrastruktur am Boden bereitstellen, um Sprach- und Internetverbindungen zwischen handelsüblichen Mobilgeräten und Satelliten herzustellen, hieß es weiter. Die Satelliten sollten von einem noch auszuwählenden Partner bereitgestellt werden. Im Rahmen dieser Initiative erhielten sämtliche europäischen Mobilfunkanbieter diskriminierungsfreien Zugang zu dem Satellitennetz. In Europa werden die Lizenzen zur Nutzung bestimmter Funkfrequenzen für die Satelliten-Kommunikation demnächst neu vergeben. Die EU-Kommission hat dabei einen Teil des Spektrums für europäische Anbieter reserviert. Die US-Regierung droht einem Medienbericht zufolge mit "[USN:L8N46408J TEXT:"verheerenden"]" Vergeltungsmaßnahmen, sollte der Marktzugang für US-Unternehmen wie Starlink eingeschränkt werden. Die Tochter des Weltraumkonzerns SpaceX (SPCX.O) ist der mit Abstand weltgrößte Satellitenbetreiber und hat in den USA für mehrere Milliarden Dollar Funkfrequenzen erworben, um den dortigen Mobilfunkern Konkurrenz zu machen.

item.title: 製造業中心の日本、攻撃者にとって高価値＝トレンドマイクロＣＥＯ
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 １９日 ロイター] - トレンドマイクロのエバ・チェン社長は１９日、都内で記...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
製造業中心の日本、攻撃者にとって高価値＝トレンドマイクロＣＥＯ 18:33 配信

2022年9月20日、台湾・台北で撮影されたトレンドマイクロのブース。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 １９日 ロイター] - トレンドマイクロのエバ・チェン社長は１９日、都内で記者会見し、サイバー攻撃は世界的に増えているものの、日本で特に急増していると述べた。背景として、日本が経済大国で、かつ製造業が基幹産業であること、また企業が正確な記録を整然と保存しているため攻撃者にとって価値が高いことを挙げた。

製造業が狙われる理由としては、生産や製造のプロセスが止まれば大きな被害が出るため「（攻撃者にとっては）より多くの金銭を稼ぐチャンスがある」と述べた。また、日本語という言語の壁がこれまで攻撃を抑制してきたものの「ＡＩ（人工知能）によって壁が消えた」とも指摘した。

チェン氏は、日本が既存のサイバーセキュリティ―インフラに頼り過ぎてきたとの見方も示した。同社の法人向けセキュリティープラットフォーム「トレンドＡＩ　ビジョン・ワン」の採用率は世界で５０％超なのに対し、日本では約２０％にとどまっているとし「日本の顧客、市民の一人一人がもっと警戒心を持って対応する必要がある」と語った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：中国メーカー、欧州高級車市場に照準　「知能化」で攻略へ コラム：ＩＭＦ総会発言から読み解く、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長の政策思想＝井上哲也氏 中国第3四半期ＧＤＰ、前年比＋4.5％に加速：識者はこうみる アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：サイバー攻撃のリスク、顧客だけでなく保険業界も動揺 最終更新: 10/19(月) 18:33 ロイター

item.title: South African business confidence eases slightly in September on oil price uncertainty
item.description: South African business confidence eased slightly in September on renewed uncertainty over global energy prices, a survey showed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South African business confidence eased slightly in September on renewed uncertainty over global energy prices, a survey showed on Monday. The South African Chamber of Commerce and Industry's Business Confidence Index (ZABCI=ECI) fell to 134.3 in September from 135.1 in August The chamber, which releases the index every two months, said rising energy costs remained a key concern for businesses because they increase operating expenses and place pressure on profitability Despite the slight monthly decline, the index is significantly higher than a year earlier Factors supporting improved business confidence over the past year include strong overseas tourist arrivals, vehicle sales and precious metals prices, the chamber said
